Chapter 4. Running in Production生产运行

By now, you have likely deployed your first LLM to run on Kubernetes. It responds to requests, maybe even with decent latency. But production isn't about working once—it's about working consistently, at scale and under load.

到目前为止，你大概率已经把第一个 LLM 部署到 Kubernetes 上跑起来了。它能响应请求，延迟或许还不错。但生产环境追求的不是“能跑通一次”，而是在规模和负载下始终如一地稳定运行。

This chapter is all about that transition. This chapter covers what it takes to make LLM inference stable and efficient in real-world scenarios. This includes expected topics like parameter tuning, along with easily overlooked aspects like runtime memory planning, routing sticky requests to cache-warm replicas, model compression decisions, and advanced topologies that require dedicated network configuration.

本章就讲这次转变：在真实场景下让 LLM 推理稳定、高效需要做什么。既包括你能想到的参数调优，也包括容易被忽略的方面——运行时内存规划、把粘性请求路由到缓存已预热的副本、模型压缩决策，以及需要专用网络配置的高级拓扑。

Treating a model server like any other container is tempting. Just set a few resource limits, expose a service, and call it a day. But GenAI workloads have unique characteristics (massive models, variable request costs, and GPU-intensive operations) that require specialized configuration. You'll learn how to configure the platform effectively while avoiding the traps that can quietly erode performance and burn through your GPU budget.

把模型服务器当成普通容器来对待是很有诱惑力的：设几个资源限制、暴露一个 Service，就收工了。但生成式 AI 负载有其独特之处（巨大的模型、差异巨大的请求成本、GPU 密集型操作），需要专门的配置。你将学会如何有效地配置平台，同时避开那些悄悄侵蚀性能、烧掉 GPU 预算的陷阱。

This chapter covers five key areas:

本章覆盖五个关键领域：

  • Model and runtime tuning: selecting, evaluating, compressing, and benchmarking models.模型与运行时调优：模型的选择、评估、压缩与基准测试。
  • Autoscaling: strategies specific to LLM workloads.自动扩缩容：面向 LLM 负载的专属策略。
  • Optimizing vLLM startup time: reducing deployment latency.优化 vLLM 启动时间：降低部署延迟。
  • LLM-aware routing: intelligent request distribution.LLM 感知路由：智能请求分发。
  • Disaggregated serving: advanced distributed architectures.解耦式服务：高级分布式架构。

The most fundamental decision is how to pick and tune a model that matches your use case without wasting compute cycles.

最根本的决策是：如何挑选并调好一个匹配你用例的模型，同时不浪费算力。

Model and Runtime Tuning
模型与运行时调优

Probably the most important aspect to consider when a team approaches the development of the first real application based on generative AI is the selection of the model to use. Most teams begin with a managed service like OpenAI's ChatGPT where configuration options are limited. However, in many situations, on-premise infrastructure is a must-have. The selection of the model at that point is critical. This selection is based on many different factors, like type of task, type of workload (i.e., real time versus batch inference), and number of concurrent requests.

当一个团队开始开发第一个基于生成式 AI 的真实应用时，要考虑的最重要的事情大概就是选哪个模型。多数团队从 OpenAI ChatGPT 这类托管服务起步，配置项很有限。但在很多场景下，必须使用本地基础设施，这时模型选择就变得至关重要。这种选择取决于多种因素：任务类型、负载类型（实时还是批量推理）、并发请求数等。

The size of the model matters, but two models with the same size might have different model architectures and training techniques, with the consequence that the results of the same query can go from being very accurate to completely wrong. Given the criticality of this selection, finding a starting point is challenging. The number of models available is very high and new models are published frequently, making the selection process daunting.

模型规模固然重要，但两个参数量相同的模型可能架构和训练技术迥异，导致同一个查询的结果可能从非常准确变成完全错误。由于这一选择至关重要，找到一个起点并不容易。可用模型数量庞大、新模型又不断发布，让选择过程令人望而生畏。

There is no silver bullet or single model to rule them all, but the selection process should not consider all models available on Hugging Face. One of the common tasks when developing a predictive AI model includes checking and comparing models trained for the same task, based on their accuracy, so it should be useful to find one or more metrics to compare the accuracy of LLMs.

没有银弹，也没有一个“通吃所有场景”的模型；但选择过程也不该把 Hugging Face 上所有模型都过一遍。开发预测式 AI 模型时，常见做法之一就是按准确率对比训练于同一任务的多个模型；因此，找到一两个指标来比较 LLM 的准确率也同样有用。

Traditional predictive AI models are trained to solve specific problems. In contrast, LLMs are trained on vast datasets and can perform multiple tasks. To compare LLMs effectively, first identify the critical task for your application, then select accuracy metrics based on that task.

传统预测式 AI 模型是为解决特定问题训练的；而 LLM 在海量数据集上训练，能执行多种任务。要有效比较 LLM，先确定你应用最关键的任务，再基于该任务选择准确率指标。

This phase is critical to guide model selection and base it on specific metrics instead of manual testing. The problem is very complex, and an entire research field about language model evaluation exists to address it.

这一阶段至关重要：它让模型选择基于具体指标而非人工测试。这个问题非常复杂，甚至存在一个专门研究语言模型评估的学术领域来应对它。

Language Model Evaluation
语言模型评估

The evaluation of a language model can target many different aspects such as measuring how knowledgeable a model is, or the model's ability to produce content without toxic language, or even how good a model is with reasoning tasks. This definition is not specific to LLMs; the same principle applies to many traditional language models defined before the LLM era.

语言模型评估可以针对很多方面：衡量模型知识储备、模型生成不含毒性语言的能力，甚至模型在推理任务上的表现。这个定义并非 LLM 独有；同样的原则也适用于 LLM 时代之前的许多传统语言模型。

One of the most important applications of language evaluation is to verify model safety with specific tasks to measure model toxicity or robustness.

语言评估最重要的应用之一，就是通过特定任务验证模型安全性，衡量模型的毒性或鲁棒性。

Many different projects provide one or more evaluation benchmarks; one of the most-used suites is EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness that includes more than one hundred out-of-the-box tasks. There are other libraries too, and new evaluation techniques are often defined to test the models in scenarios that are increasingly complex.

许多项目提供一个或多个评估基准；最常用的套件之一是 EleutherAI 的 lm-evaluation-harness，开箱即用的任务超过一百个。此外还有其他库，新的评估技术也在不断涌现，用于在越来越复杂的场景下测试模型。

Traditionally, an evaluation task includes a dataset with a set of inputs and outputs to use (usually as multichoice questionnaires to simplify the analysis), and an evaluation function to compute the metric. This format makes it very easy for a subject matter expert to review the dataset, and it can be easily grouped into subtopics to better categorize the model's abilities.

传统上，一个评估任务包含一个数据集（一组输入输出，通常做成多选题以简化分析）和一个计算指标的评估函数。这种格式让领域专家很容易审阅数据集，也能方便地按子主题分组，从而更好地归类模型的各项能力。

Each benchmark is essentially a procedure that invokes the target model with a set of predefined question-answer pairs and analyzes the results, so it takes time (even hours) to run it, and the model must be deployed, so it can be very expensive to perform. Fortunately, for all the most-used models it is possible to find online leaderboards that collect the evaluation results for multiple benchmarks, allowing for easy comparison.

每个基准本质上是一个流程：用一组预定义的问答对调用目标模型并分析结果，因此跑一次要花时间（甚至数小时），而且必须先把模型部署起来，代价可能很高。幸运的是，对最常用的模型，你可以在网上找到收集了多个基准结果的排行榜，方便横向比较。

A leaderboard is a table where different models are compared using one or more metrics. At the same time, the usage of similar leaderboards has security and trust implications because there is no way to verify if the published numbers are true without locally re-executing the test. The general advice is to use the leaderboards to perform the initial assessment to produce a short list of models, and then perform additional analysis.

排行榜就是一张按一个或多个指标对比不同模型的表。同时，使用这类排行榜也有安全与信任方面的隐患：不在本地重跑测试，就无法验证公布数字是否真实。通用建议是：先用排行榜做初筛，得到一个候选短名单，再做进一步分析。

A good starting point is the leaderboard page on the Hugging Face website that links many of them grouped by categories like mathematics abilities or model safety. The Open LLM Leaderboard, for example, compares models across multiple benchmarks, including MMLU (knowledge), HellaSwag (commonsense reasoning), and TruthfulQA (truthfulness).

一个好的起点是 Hugging Face 网站上的排行榜页面，它按数学能力、模型安全等类别汇集了多个榜单。例如 Open LLM Leaderboard 就在多个基准上对比模型，包括 MMLU（知识）、HellaSwag（常识推理）和 TruthfulQA（真实性）。

When you identify models to evaluate locally, understanding how the evaluation process works is essential. See Figure 4-1 for the execution flow of an evaluation request.

当你确定要在本地评估哪些模型时，理解评估流程如何运作就至关重要。图 4-1 给出了一次评估请求的执行流程。

原书第 159 页

Given that each task can take multiple minutes to perform, it is usually done asynchronously inside an automated pipeline. For example, the TrustyAI project provides a wrapper of the lm-evaluation-harness library introducing the LMEvalJob CRD to perform the task and to notify when it has completed. A full example can be found in the TrustyAI LM-Eval documentation.

由于每个任务都要跑好几分钟，评估通常是在自动化流水线中异步执行的。例如 TrustyAI 项目封装了 lm-evaluation-harness 库，引入 LMEvalJob CRD 来执行任务并在完成时通知。完整示例见 TrustyAI LM-Eval 文档。

In addition to the hundreds of existing evaluation tasks, you can create a custom one, but then you cannot easily compare different models or a different version of the models using online leaderboards.

除了已有的数百个评估任务，你也可以自定义一个；但这样一来，就难以再用在线排行榜在不同模型或模型不同版本之间做横向比较了。

One of the most-used benchmarks is Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) because its dataset covers a large set of multiple-choice questions from various branches of knowledge that are grouped by tasks, including a very large set of topics: abstract algebra, high school European history, high school government, politics, and much more. The same approach has been extended to cover multimodal models by Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding (MMMU).

最常用的基准之一是大规模多任务语言理解（MMLU），因为它的数据集覆盖了大量来自各知识分支的多选题，并按任务分组，主题极广：抽象代数、高中欧洲史、高中政治、政治学等等。同样的思路已被扩展到多模态模型，即大规模多学科多模态理解（MMMU）。

While general-purpose benchmarks evaluate fundamental capabilities, production LLM applications often require specialized evaluation tools targeting specific use cases and risks. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems (see Chapter 8) need metrics that assess both retrieval quality and generation accuracy, while security-focused deployments require vulnerability scanning to identify potential risks like prompt injection or harmful output generation. Two frameworks address these specialized needs: Ragas provides metrics specifically designed for RAG applications, measuring context relevance, answer faithfulness, and retrieval accuracy; while NVIDIA garak is a vulnerability scanner that probes LLMs for security weaknesses, testing resistance to prompt injection, jailbreaking attempts, and generation of harmful content.

通用基准评估的是基础能力，而生产 LLM 应用往往需要针对特定用例与风险的专门评估工具。检索增强生成（RAG）系统（见第 8 章）需要同时评估检索质量与生成准确性的指标；面向安全的部署则需要漏洞扫描，识别提示注入、有害输出生成等潜在风险。有两个框架分别应对这些专门需求：Ragas 提供专为 RAG 应用设计的指标，衡量上下文相关性、答案忠实度与检索准确率；NVIDIA garak 则是漏洞扫描器，探测 LLM 的安全弱点，测试其对提示注入、越狱尝试和有害内容生成的抵抗能力。

原书第 160 页

Model selection happens early in the project lifecycle, but evaluation doesn't stop there. The same evaluation techniques become critical when optimizing the model for production. Data scientists and AI engineers initially select the model, but before running it at scale, you need to optimize it. A model can be compressed using quantization techniques, or you can collect production data and use it to distill the model into a smaller one.

模型选择发生在项目早期，但评估并不会就此停止。在为生产优化模型时，同样的评估技术变得至关重要。数据科学家与 AI 工程师最初选好模型后，在大规模运行之前还需要优化：可以用量化技术压缩模型，也可以收集生产数据把模型蒸馏成更小的版本。

Both compression techniques modify the model weights, which impacts overall accuracy. This requires performing the evaluation again to measure the impact.

这两种压缩技术都会改动模型权重，从而影响整体准确率，因此需要重新评估以衡量影响。

The application of similar techniques can produce a model that is less than half of the original size, doubling or tripling the throughput of the runtime on the same hardware with essentially the same accuracy of the original model. When properly applied, the compressed model can recover more than 99% of the original accuracy.

合理应用这些技术，可以让模型体积缩小到原来的一半以下，在相同硬件上把运行时吞吐提升两到三倍，而准确率几乎与原模型持平。应用得当时，压缩模型可以恢复原模型 99% 以上的准确率。

Language Model Compression
语言模型压缩

An LLM like Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct has eight billion parameters. This means that there are eight billion floating point values and each of them is used as weight (multiplier) for the corresponding input of the neural network.

像 Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 这样的 LLM 有 80 亿个参数。这意味着有 80 亿个浮点数，每一个都作为神经网络对应输入的权重（乘数）。

Each floating point value is represented with 16 bits, so the minimal memory requirement to load the model is 16 GB (16 bits x 8 billion). Such neural networks might have numerous layers (say, 32), with each neuron's output feeding into the subsequent layer, increasing the overall memory footprint of the model. This is called activation, and it is another 16-bit floating point value.

每个浮点数用 16 位表示，因此加载模型的最低内存需求是 16 GB（16 位 × 80 亿）。这类神经网络可能有很多层（比如 32 层），每个神经元的输出送入下一层，进一步增加模型的整体内存占用。这就是激活值，它同样是一个 16 位浮点数。

Finally, both the KV cache values and the intermediate output results are represented using 16-bit precision. For more details on this topic, see "Understanding LLM Fundamentals" on page xxv.

最后，KV 缓存值和中间输出结果也都用 16 位精度表示。详见第 xxv 页“理解 LLM 基础”。

All of these floating point numbers add up to the total memory footprint of an LLM for the GPU memory. The technique to compress the model is called quantization (see the following sidebar).

所有这些浮点数加起来，就是 LLM 在 GPU 显存上的总内存占用。压缩模型的技术称为量化（见下面侧栏）。

Sidebar: Quantization

Quantization is the name of a set of techniques that aims to reduce the total memory footprint using a less precise representation, like an 8-bit floating point (FP8) or an integer representation (INT8). These techniques go beyond simply rounding floating points or reducing decimals. Instead, they involve mechanisms specifically designed to compensate for errors during execution.

量化是一组技术的统称，目标是用更低精度的表示（如 8 位浮点 FP8 或整数 INT8）来减少总内存占用。这些技术并不只是简单地四舍五入或减少小数位，而是包含专门设计的机制，用于补偿执行过程中产生的误差。
原书第 161 页

Model compression alone isn't sufficient. If the runtime lacks native quantization support, it must convert the compressed model back to 16-bit precision during processing to evaluate the neural network and produce activations. The sweet spot of quantization is a runtime that has optimized kernel implementations (GPU functions) that can process quantized data end to end. This enables the scalability improvements.

仅做模型压缩还不够。如果运行时不原生支持量化，它在处理时就必须把压缩后的模型转回 16 位精度，才能计算神经网络并产生激活值。量化的最佳搭配，是运行时拥有优化的 kernel 实现（GPU 函数），能够端到端地处理量化数据，这样才能真正带来可扩展性提升。

The vLLM runtime has native support for most of the quantization techniques, both on the compression side with the LLM compressor project, but especially on the runtime side with multiple optimized kernels that are automatically enabled when the runtime detects that the model is quantized.

vLLM 运行时原生支持大多数量化技术：压缩侧有 llmcompressor 项目，而更重要的是运行时侧——它内置多个优化 kernel，一旦检测到模型是量化过的就会自动启用。

This area of research looks very promising to make LLM serving more cost-effective, potentially becoming the future standard for models and runtimes, but some critical aspects remain. First of all, the specialized kernels that are critical to properly scale quantized models are hardware-specific so not all GPUs support it yet, and in general it is possible to have a dramatic accuracy drop when the quantization goes wrong.

这个研究方向看起来非常有希望让 LLM 服务更具性价比，可能成为未来模型与运行时的标准；但仍有一些关键问题。首先，正确扩展量化模型所依赖的专用 kernel 是硬件相关的，并非所有 GPU 都支持；其次，一旦量化出问题，准确率可能断崖式下跌。

Although the first aspect, ensuring comprehensive GPU coverage, may simply require time, the second aspect demands meticulous control. The compression is not lossless, so it is critical to evaluate the quality of the model after compression to make sure the level of accuracy has not been impacted too much.

前一个问题（确保 GPU 全面覆盖）可能只需要时间；后一个问题则需要精细把控。压缩并非无损，因此压缩后务必重新评估模型质量，确认准确率没有受到过大影响。

There are multiple examples of models that have been quantized to use 8-bit per floating point (FP8) and that have recovered more than 99% of the accuracy of the original model. The library llmcompressor simplifies the whole procedure with built-in calibration. Using the library is quite straightforward, but it requires some knowledge to understand the different parameters (Example 4-1).

已经有不少模型被量化为每浮点 8 位（FP8）后，恢复了原模型 99% 以上的准确率。llmcompressor 库通过内置校准简化了整个流程。用起来相当直接，但要理解各个参数仍需一些知识（例 4-1）。

Example 4-1. Compress an LLM using llmcompressor

from llmcompressor.modifiers.quantization import GPTQModifier
from llmcompressor.modifiers.smoothquant import SmoothQuantModifier
from llmcompressor.transformers import oneshot

# Select quantization algorithm. In this case, we:
#   * apply SmoothQuant to make the activations easier to quantize
#   * quantize the weights to int8 with GPTQ (static per channel)
#   * quantize the activations to int8 (dynamic per token)
recipe = [
    SmoothQuantModifier(smoothing_strength=0.8),
    GPTQModifier(scheme="W8A8", targets="Linear", ignore=["lm_head"]),
]
# Apply quantization using the built-in open_platypus dataset.
oneshot(
    model="TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0",
    dataset="open_platypus",
    recipe=recipe,
    output_dir="TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0-INT8",
    max_seq_length=2048,
    num_calibration_samples=512,
)
原书第 162 页
  • recipe 定义要应用的量化流水线，可包含一种或多种技术。
  • W8A8 表示权重用 8 位量化，激活值同样用 8 位。
  • 必须指定一个数据集用于量化校准。
  • 输出目录会包含压缩后的模型以及服务模型所需的全部配置文件（config.json、tokenizer.json 等），让 vLLM 无需额外自定义参数即可加载。

A good practice is to use language model evaluation techniques to compute the accuracy metrics of the original model before deployment to production. Furthermore, integrating compression directly into the MLOps/LLMOps pipeline provides an optimized starting point for the system. This approach eliminates the need for custom configuration.

一个好做法是在上线前先用语言模型评估技术算出原模型的准确率指标。此外，把压缩直接集成进 MLOps/LLMOps 流水线，能为系统提供一个经过优化的起点，也省去了自定义配置的麻烦。

Sidebar: Compression caution

Model compression is a complex process with significant risks. Improper quantization can dramatically impact model quality, leading to degraded accuracy, hallucinations, or incorrect outputs. While tools like llmcompressor provide calibration features, achieving optimal compression requires expertise and thorough evaluation. An alternative approach is to use models that have already been professionally compressed and validated by organizations with compression expertise. For example, Red Hat AI on Hugging Face releases pre-compressed models that have been carefully quantized and evaluated, providing production-ready compressed models without the risk of improper compression.

模型压缩是一个复杂且风险不低的过程。不当的量化会显著影响模型质量，导致准确率下降、幻觉或错误输出。虽然 llmcompressor 这类工具提供了校准功能，但要达到最佳压缩效果仍需要专业经验与充分评估。另一种思路是直接使用由具备压缩专长的机构预先压缩并验证过的模型。例如 Red Hat AI 在 Hugging Face 上发布的预压缩模型，都经过仔细量化与评估，可直接用于生产，避免自行压缩不当的风险。

Model Performance Benchmark
模型性能基准测试

Chapter 5 covers how to observe an LLM and which metrics are critical to track usage and system responsiveness, in particular for real-time use cases like a chatbot. Reacting quickly is crucial to resolve latency issues by properly configuring scaling, rate limiting, or even rejecting new requests with appropriate error messages.

第 5 章会讲如何观测 LLM、哪些指标对跟踪使用情况与系统响应能力至关重要，尤其是聊天机器人这类实时场景。快速反应很关键：通过正确配置扩缩容、限流，甚至以合适的错误信息拒绝新请求，来解决延迟问题。

Regardless of the mitigation action that will apply to the system, the prerequisite is to measure the overall system behavior under different conditions and with different workloads.

无论最终对系统采取哪种缓解措施，前提都是先在不同条件、不同负载下度量系统的整体行为。

To measure system behavior effectively, you need specialized tools. The LLM community has developed several comprehensive benchmarking tools, which we'll explore next.

要有效度量系统行为，需要专门的工具。LLM 社区已经开发了若干综合性基准测试工具，下面逐一介绍。

Performance and capacity testing isn't new to software development. Every mature release pipeline should include it, and a served model from an end-to-end perspective is very similar: it's an endpoint that accepts requests and generates responses.

性能与容量测试在软件开发中并不新鲜。每个成熟的发布流水线都应包含它；从端到端视角看，一个被服务起来的模型非常相似：它就是一个接受请求、生成响应的端点。

Various tools are available for performance testings, allowing you to invoke an endpoint. A runtime can be tested with traditional load generators. This is how LLM performance testing has been done, and it is still sometimes used. Over time, more specialized tools have been developed that can compute more specialized metrics and mix performance testing and model evaluation, combining different scenarios and datasets.

有各种性能测试工具可以调用端点。用传统压测工具就能测运行时——LLM 性能测试最初就是这么做的，现在偶尔还会用。随着时间推移，更专业的工具被开发出来，能计算更专门的指标，并把性能测试与模型评估结合起来，组合不同场景与数据集。

The LLM community is very active and many different tools are available. Some of the most comprehensive are:

LLM 社区非常活跃，可用工具很多，其中较综合的几个是：

GuideLLM

The GuideLLM project was created specifically as a tool to evaluate a model and optimize the deployment of LLMs. It simulates different types of workloads to be equivalent to a real-world scenario. GuideLLM can be used as an interactive tool to gauge performance and use of resources with a specific hardware configuration. The tool covers a large set of rate scenarios that can be configured, from a synchronous scenario, where every request is chained one after the other, to more advanced scenarios with fixed concurrency or even Poisson distribution with the mean at a specified rate. After the benchmark, GuideLLM produces a report with the latency distribution and other useful information. Example 4-2 shows how to call GuideLLM from the command line, resulting in an output shown in Figure 4-2.

GuideLLM 项目专门为评估模型、优化 LLM 部署而设计。它模拟不同类型的负载，使其贴近真实场景。GuideLLM 可作为交互式工具，在特定硬件配置下衡量性能与资源使用。它覆盖大量可配置的速率场景：从请求一个接一个串行的同步场景，到固定并发、甚至以指定速率为均值的泊松分布等更高级场景。基准测试结束后，GuideLLM 会生成包含延迟分布和其他有用信息的报告。例 4-2 展示如何在命令行调用 GuideLLM，输出见图 4-2。

Example 4-2. Run a benchmark with GuideLLM

guidellm benchmark \
  --target http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
  --model mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 \
  --output-path output_file.json \
  --rate-type sweep \
  --data 'prompt_tokens=256,output_tokens=128' \
  --max-seconds 400 \
  --warmup-percent 0.2

MLPerf Inference

The challenge to properly test the performance of machine learning models is not new or limited to LLMs, and indeed there are communities where companies, individual contributors, and academics are collaborating to define tools and publish results. MLCommons is an AI engineering consortium, built on a philosophy of open collaboration to improve AI systems. This organization provides many different tools, one of which is MLPerf Inference, and it has been extended over time to support LLMs. The results are published periodically on the MLCommons website for data center configurations (MLPerf Inference: Datacenter) and Edge/devices (MLPerf Inference: Edge).

正确测试机器学习模型性能这一挑战并不新鲜，也不限于 LLM。实际上已有一些社区，由公司、个人贡献者和学者共同协作定义工具并发布结果。MLCommons 是一个 AI 工程联盟，秉持开放协作、改进 AI 系统的理念。它提供多种工具，其中之一就是 MLPerf Inference，并已逐步扩展支持 LLM。结果会定期发布在 MLCommons 网站上，分为数据中心配置（MLPerf Inference: Datacenter）和边缘/设备（MLPerf Inference: Edge）两类。

Inference Perf

Inference Perf is a GenAI inference performance benchmarking tool proposed and incubated by the Kubernetes WG-Serving group and sponsored by the Kubernetes SIG Scalability. This community effort includes support from different companies. It is specialized for generative AI, and you can specify an arbitrary dataset to simulate a scenario that is similar to a real-world situation. The library can run locally or deploy in a cluster connecting to a previously deployed model with the assumption that it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API.

Inference Perf 是由 Kubernetes WG-Serving 小组提议并孵化、Kubernetes SIG Scalability 赞助的生成式 AI 推理性能基准测试工具。这个社区项目得到了多家公司的支持。它专为生成式 AI 设计，可以指定任意数据集来模拟贴近真实的场景。该库既可本地运行，也可部署到集群中，连接到一个已部署好的模型——前提是该模型暴露兼容 OpenAI 的 API。

vLLM benchmark suite

Performance is a critical aspect for inference engines like vLLM, which provides publicly available nightly benchmark jobs with instructions. It is not a proper tool but more like a set of scripts that can be used to measure the performance of a specific model or hardware configuration.

对 vLLM 这类推理引擎而言，性能至关重要；它公开了带说明文档的每夜基准测试任务。这算不上一个正式工具，更像一组脚本，可用于测量特定模型或硬件配置的性能。

As mentioned before, while other traditional load generators can be used, this would require implementing the LLM-specific metrics like Time to First Token (TTFT) and Inter-Token Latency (ITL). Whatever tool has been selected to measure the performance, the integration in the CI/CD system is usually quite straightforward and is enough to create a task that deploys the model then performs the test using the tool. The most critical aspect is to use an environment that is equivalent to the production cluster, especially regarding the model and the number of GPUs where the model is deployed.

如前所述，虽然也可以用其他传统压测工具，但那样就需要自己实现 LLM 专属指标，如首 token 时间（TTFT）和 token 间延迟（ITL）。无论选哪个工具测性能，集成到 CI/CD 系统通常都很直接：建一个任务，先部署模型再用工具跑测试即可。最关键的一点是，测试环境要与生产集群等价，尤其是模型本身和部署模型所用的 GPU 数量。

Integrating the performance test in the release pipeline and storing the result is critical to properly size the cluster and learn the capacity limits. These numbers are critical for capacity planning and for configuring rate limiting or the API gateway.

把性能测试集成进发布流水线并保存结果，对于正确评估集群规模、摸清容量上限至关重要。这些数据对容量规划、限流配置和 API 网关配置都非常关键。

vLLM Runtime Parameters Tuning
vLLM 运行时参数调优

"Understanding LLM Fundamentals" on page xxv explained how the inference of LLM works, which metrics are important to monitor, and how important the KV cache is to make LLM serving efficient. The model is now compressed and ready to be deployed. Thanks to the performance tests, data related to overall system performance can be used to guide the runtime tuning.

第 xxv 页“理解 LLM 基础”讲解了 LLM 推理如何运作、应监控哪些指标，以及 KV 缓存对高效 LLM 服务有多重要。现在模型已压缩好、可以部署了。借助性能测试得到的数据，我们可以指导运行时调优。

This section is specific to vLLM runtime, but most of the content applies to other LLM runtimes, too.

本节针对 vLLM 运行时，但大部分内容也适用于其他 LLM 运行时。

The development of a vLLM project is very active; new optimizations and new models are added weekly. Improved defaults are implemented in every release, so in most cases it does not need to be tuned, and it just works. The only aspects that vLLM cannot easily infer automatically are the type of workload and the assigned hardware; this is where it is possible to help the engine with the configuration.

vLLM 项目开发非常活跃，每周都有新优化和新模型加入。每个版本都会改进默认配置，因此大多数情况下无需调优、开箱即用。vLLM 唯一难以自动推断的是负载类型和所分配的硬件；这正是你可以通过配置帮助引擎的地方。

Although the default vLLM configuration is usually a valid starting point, you need to perform some sizing analysis to calculate how much VRAM memory the GPU needs (see the following sidebar for detailed calculation guidelines).

虽然 vLLM 默认配置通常是个合理起点，但你仍需要做一些容量测算，估算 GPU 需要多少显存（详细计算方法见下面侧栏）。

Sidebar: How to Calculate Model Memory Requirements

Many different factors contribute to the definition of the memory requirements. Most of them are related to the model architecture and the model size, together with the number of concurrent requests.

The main driver of a model's memory requirements is the number of parameters: a model with 8 billion (8B) parameters requires way less memory compared to very large models that can reach more than 400 billion parameters.

Each parameter in a full-size model typically occupies 2 bytes (16 bits, float16 or bfloat16) of memory. Through compression techniques, this can be reduced to 1 byte (8 bits, FP8 or INT8) per parameter. Multiplying the number of parameters with the size of each produces the baseline memory requirement.

In addition to this baseline, some infrastructure space related to the optimized kernels is loaded to the GPU, usually between 300 MB and 2 GB.

The cost of the activations that represent the intermediate status during the execution should also be considered. It is directly related to the hidden size value and the number of layers. Both of these values can be found in the config.json file for the model (i.e., 40 layers). Activation memory requirements might be limited to 200–300 MB when the sequence length is small (i.e., 512), but this changes dramatically with larger sequences because the cost grows quadratically.

Finally, the output generation requires an output tensor with a cost that is directly related to the vocabulary size, the sequence length, and the batch size.

For a full example with a 8B model that uses parameters of float16 format, 2048 context size, and batch size 1: the baseline memory requirement is about 16 GB (8 billion x 2 bytes). It is usually necessary to consider about 1 GB of additional memory for the infrastructure, activation space of about 900 MB (assuming 4096 as the hidden size), and finally about 400 MB for the output layer.

The total VRAM requirement is about 17.3 GB, which seems reasonable. However, simply increasing the batch size to 10 for processing multiple requests simultaneously almost doubles this requirement, pushing it to over 28 GB of VRAM.

This topic is much larger than this simplified example. New techniques and model architectures are defined frequently, changing the memory implications. For example, there are ongoing evolutions like the Mamba LLM architecture that should dramatically reduce the size requirements for the KV cache.

Online tools can help this calculation, such as TitanML's Model Memory Calculator. To learn more, including all the formulas that have been applied, we highly recommend the detailed information found in this blogpost from Alexander Smirnov and in the EleutherAI's blog.

内存需求由多种因素共同决定，大多与模型架构、模型规模以及并发请求数相关。最主要的驱动因素是参数量：80 亿（8B）参数的模型，比那些参数量超过 4000 亿的超大模型所需内存少得多。全精度模型中每个参数通常占 2 字节（16 位，float16 或 bfloat16）；通过压缩技术可降到每参数 1 字节（8 位，FP8 或 INT8）。参数量乘以每个参数的字节数，就是基线内存需求。在此基线之外，GPU 还会加载与优化 kernel 相关的基础设施空间，通常在 300 MB 到 2 GB 之间。还要考虑执行过程中表示中间状态的激活值开销，它与 hidden size 和层数直接相关，这两个值都可在模型的 config.json 中找到（例如 40 层）。序列长度较小时（如 512）激活内存可能只有 200–300 MB，但序列变长时开销平方级增长，变化巨大。最后，输出生成需要一个输出张量，其开销与词表大小、序列长度和 batch size 直接相关。举个完整例子：一个 8B 模型，参数为 float16，上下文 2048，batch size 为 1，基线内存约 16 GB（80 亿 × 2 字节）；再加约 1 GB 基础设施、约 900 MB 激活空间（假设 hidden size 为 4096）和约 400 MB 输出层，总显存约 17.3 GB，看起来合理。但仅把 batch size 提到 10 以并发处理多个请求，显存需求就几乎翻倍到 28 GB 以上。这个话题远大于这个简化例子：新技术和新模型架构层出不穷，不断改变内存占用。例如 Mamba LLM 架构这类演进有望大幅降低 KV 缓存的体积需求。TitanML 的 Model Memory Calculator 等在线工具可以辅助计算；如需了解全部公式，强烈推荐 Alexander Smirnov 的博客文章和 EleutherAI 博客中的详细资料。
原书第 167 页

The vLLM runtime greedily utilizes available resources to maximize throughput. Therefore, having more resources directly improves performance. In a perfect scenario, vLLM has enough GPU memory to load the model into VRAM. It also has enough space for activations (the intermediate results of each neural network layer) and for the KV cache. This ensures that the runtime never needs to evict and recompute data that's still necessary.

vLLM 运行时会贪婪地利用可用资源以最大化吞吐。因此，资源越多，性能越好。在理想情况下，vLLM 有足够显存把模型加载进去，也有足够空间放激活值（各神经网络层的中间结果）和 KV 缓存。这样运行时就永远不需要驱逐并重算仍在使用的数据。

When this is not the case, the first symptom is going to be a higher inter-token latency and implicitly less throughput. This is not the only way to detect it because vLLM is usually explicit in the logs when there are similar scenarios. We look at startup logs from vLLM in Example 5-1, but Example 4-3 focuses on memory information.

当显存不足时，首要症状是 token 间延迟升高、吞吐随之下降。这并非唯一的检测方式，因为 vLLM 在这种情况下通常会在日志里明确提示。例 5-1 会看 vLLM 的启动日志，而例 4-3 聚焦于内存信息。

Example 4-3. vLLM logs information about memory

...
INFO [model_runner.py:1097] Loading model weights took 14.9888 GB
INFO [worker.py:241] Memory profiling takes 0.67 seconds
INFO [worker.py:241] the current vLLM instance can use total_gpu_memory (79.14GiB)
        x gpu_memory_utilization (0.90) = 71.22GiB
INFO [worker.py:241] model weights take 14.99GiB; non_torch_memory takes 0.12GiB;
        PyTorch activation peak memory takes 1.19GiB; the rest of the memory
        reserved for KV Cache is 54.93GiB.
...
WARNING [scheduler.py:1057] Sequence group 0 is preempted by PreemptionMode.SWAP
        mode because there is not enough KV cache space. This can affect the
        end-to-end performance. Increase gpu_memory_utilization or
        tensor_parallel_size to provide more KV cache memory.
        total_cumulative_preemption_cnt=1
原书第 168 页
  • vLLM 启动、模型加载到显存后，日志会打印权重占用大小。
  • 一条非常有用的日志，说明 vLLM 可用的 GPU 总显存。
  • 除模型权重外，引擎还会占用一些额外内存。
  • 激活值也占内存：“峰值”取决于一次执行中激活了多少神经网络节点。例如在 MoE（混合专家）架构中，每次只激活模型的一部分。
  • 剩余内存分配给 KV 缓存。
  • 模型执行时，当 KV 缓存不足、vLLM 不得不把部分值换出显存时，会打出这条日志。

The log explicitly reports the information when the size allocated to the KV cache is not big enough. A single entry of this log is probably not critical, but when this happens multiple times, it is probably better to consider applying some tuning. Fortunately, the log is very detailed, so the log message includes some suggestions to try to address the problem. The following parameters are important to consider:

当分配给 KV 缓存的空间不足时，日志会明确报告。单次出现可能不严重，但如果反复发生，就该考虑调优了。幸运的是日志非常详细，消息中还包含解决建议。以下参数值得重点关注：

  • gpu-memory-utilization: default 0.9, the fraction of available memory vLLM may use. It caps vLLM's memory to avoid the OOM errors of earlier versions. As stability improved, it is often safe to raise this closer to 1.0 to claim that extra 10%.gpu-memory-utilization：默认 0.9，表示 vLLM 可用内存的百分比。它限制 vLLM 内存占用，避免早期版本中超出 GPU 显存导致的 OOM 错误。随着 vLLM 稳定性提升，现在常可以安全地把它调到接近 1.0，以利用那额外 10% 的内存。
  • max-model-len: must be set for the specific LLM use case. KV cache size directly tracks context size (input prompt + generated text). Tuning it directly affects memory, but too aggressive a context cap can starve responses of needed tokens (e.g. RAG needs substantial context).max-model-len：必须根据具体 LLM 用例配置。KV 缓存大小直接对应上下文长度（输入 prompt + 生成文本）。调它会直接影响内存，但对上下文限制过严会导致回答 token 不足，无法满足用例（例如 RAG 通常需要较大上下文）。
  • max-num-seqs / max-num-batched-tokens: vLLM batches inputs to raise GPU usage and throughput. This has some latency implications but is usually negligible in high-concurrency production. Larger batches need larger KV cache; you can lower these to save memory.max-num-seqs 或 max-num-batched-tokens：vLLM 会把输入批处理以提高 GPU 利用率和吞吐。这对延迟有一定影响，但在高并发生产场景中通常可忽略。同时，batch 越大所需 KV 缓存空间越大，因此可以调小这些值来节省内存。
  • tensor-parallel-size: unlike the above, raising it needs extra hardware. It shards model weights, giving each GPU more room for KV cache. Requires multiple GPUs, but intra-node cross-GPU traffic is usually not a bottleneck thanks to dedicated high-speed links. For multinode GPU setups and advanced topologies, see the network optimization and topology-aware scheduling sections in Chapter 7.tensor-parallel-size：与前面几个参数不同，增大张量并行度需要额外硬件。它把模型权重分片，让每张 GPU 上有更多空间放 KV 缓存。需要多块 GPU，但节点内跨 GPU 通信通常不是瓶颈——专用高速接口避免了通信延迟。多节点 GPU 部署与高级网络拓扑见第 7 章网络优化与拓扑感知调度两节。
  • pipeline-parallel-size: pipeline parallelism spreads model layers across GPUs, whereas tensor parallelism splits individual tensors. Both are compatible and grow available KV cache, but tensor parallelism is more common for same-node multi-GPU inference.pipeline-parallel-size：流水线并行把模型层分布到多块 GPU 上，而张量并行切分的是单个张量。两者兼容，都能增加可用 KV 缓存；但在同节点多 GPU 推理中更常用张量并行。
  • data-parallel-size: like pipeline parallelism, splits data into parallel groups, enabling multinode serving across GPUs on different servers. Useful when a cluster has more than one GPU-equipped node. It grows KV cache but introduces the complexity of multinode setups that need dedicated connectivity.data-parallel-size：与流水线并行类似，它把数据分成并行组，支持跨服务器上的 GPU 做多节点服务。当集群中有多台 GPU 服务器时适用。它能增加 KV 缓存，但也引入多节点场景的复杂度，需要专用网络连接。
  • cpu-offload-gb: offloads part of the model to CPU, enabling models larger than available GPU memory. Though tempting for KV cache management, it badly hurts throughput. It is strongly discouraged in production due to the massive performance drop and the loss of critical GPU-specific optimizations (e.g. specialized kernels) essential for efficient LLM serving.cpu-offload-gb：把模型一部分卸载到 CPU，让超过可用显存的模型也能部署。虽然对 KV 缓存管理看似有用，但会严重影响吞吐。由于性能大幅下降，并丢失高效 LLM 服务所必需的 GPU 专属优化（如专用 kernel），强烈不建议在生产中使用。
