Using these parameters and knowing the characteristics of the workload is critical to tune the runtime to maximize the performance and match the expected service-level expectation. When this is not enough, it is possible to add more GPUs to the system, but it is also possible to consider additional optimizations thanks to the Kubernetes stack, and in particular the networking part, as described in "LLM-Aware Routing" on page 139.

结合这些参数并了解负载特征，是把运行时调到性能最大化、满足预期服务水平的关键。如果仍不够，可以给系统加 GPU；但也可以借助 Kubernetes 技术栈、尤其是网络部分做更多优化，见第 139 页“LLM 感知路由”。

Autoscaling
自动扩缩容

You've optimized the model and tuned the runtime parameters. But production deployments face another challenge: variable workload. Even with a perfectly tuned single instance, you'll eventually need multiple replicas to handle peak traffic.

你已经优化了模型、调好了运行时参数。但生产部署还面临另一个挑战：负载波动。即便单个实例调得再完美，峰值流量来临时你终究还是需要多副本。

In a real-time inference scenario, end user latency is critical. Monitor the Time To First Token (TTFT) and Inter-Token Latency (ITL) metrics to guide routing and scaling. For offline inference, focus on tuning batch size and throughput instead.

在实时推理场景中，终端用户延迟至关重要。应监控首 token 时间（TTFT）和 token 间延迟（ITL）指标，以此指导路由与扩缩容。对离线推理，则应聚焦于调 batch size 和吞吐。

Kubernetes has native support for horizontal pod autoscaling that dynamically balances requests across different replicas. However, LLM workloads present specific challenges: request cost varies dramatically by token count, GPU utilization doesn't correlate with CPU/memory, and startup times can be lengthy. Similar challenges apply to distributed training workloads, which require sophisticated scheduling strategies like gang scheduling and quota management, covered in Chapter 7. The main options for autoscaling are:

Kubernetes 原生支持水平 Pod 自动扩缩容，可在多个副本间动态均衡请求。但 LLM 负载有其特殊挑战：请求成本随 token 数差异巨大、GPU 利用率与 CPU/内存不相关、启动时间可能很长。分布式训练负载也面临类似挑战，需要 gang 调度、配额管理等复杂调度策略，见第 7 章。自动扩缩容的主要选项有：

原书第 170 页
  • Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA): works out of the box with no extra deps, but primarily monitors CPU and memory. That makes it a poor fit for LLM workloads that stress GPUs — you need a more flexible autoscaler.水平 Pod 自动扩缩容器（HPA）：开箱即用、无额外依赖，但它主要监控 CPU 和内存。这让它不太适合以 GPU 为主的 LLM 负载——你需要更灵活的扩缩容方案。
  • Knative Pod Autoscaler (KPA): offered by Knative Serving, decides based on request count. Its default "stable" mode uses a time window for concurrency; a "panic" mode uses a much shorter window for fast reactions. KPA fits LLMs better than HPA and integrates natively with KServe (Knative mode), but it was built for microservices whose pods scale fast. LLMs are heavy, GPU-bound deployments that can take minutes to load depending on model size, which makes dynamic scaling impractical without heavy tuning (see "Optimize vLLM Startup Time" on page 136). Worse, request count doesn't correlate with actual runtime load — one request may produce many tokens, the next only a few.Knative Pod 自动扩缩容器（KPA）：由 Knative Serving 提供，基于请求数做决策。其默认“stable”模式用时间窗口计算并发来扩缩；另有“panic”模式，窗口短得多，能更快响应负载变化。KPA 比 HPA 更适合 LLM，且与 KServe 的 Knative 部署模式原生集成；但它是为 Pod 能快速扩缩的微服务设计的。LLM 部署沉重、依赖 GPU，加载时间随模型大小可能长达数分钟，若不做大量调优，动态扩缩并不现实（见第 136 页“优化 vLLM 启动时间”）。更重要的是，像 KPA 这种基于请求数的方式没有考虑到：请求数与运行时实际负载并不直接相关——一个请求可能生成大量 token，下一个却只有几个。
  • Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling (KEDA): built to scale event-driven workloads where the trigger is a queue message rather than an HTTP request. Its creators faced a challenge similar to LLM scaling: many event-driven techs exist with different ways to publish pressure signals (push vs. poll) and naming, so a flexible query API is needed. KEDA lets you configure a metrics query to drive scaling. This works well with vLLM, which exposes metrics like vllm:num_requests_waiting (requests still queued) or vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds / vllm:time_per_output_token_seconds. KServe natively supports KPA in Knative mode, but also KEDA in Standard mode (see "KServe" on page 20). The KEDA autoscaler is configured in the InferenceService spec with a query, and can fetch from a PodMetric directly or from an external source. If the query is limited to pod-local vLLM metrics, both are equivalent — but scraping the pod directly cuts autoscaler latency. The external source is more flexible: you can pull metrics from multiple sources (even different vLLM replicas) and run richer joined queries (see Example 4-4).Kubernetes 事件驱动自动扩缩容（KEDA）：为事件驱动负载而建，触发源不是 HTTP 请求，而是（通常来自队列的）消息。KEDA 作者面对的挑战与 LLM 扩缩类似：事件驱动技术五花八门，发布压力指标的方式（推 vs 拉）和命名各不相同，因此需要一个灵活的 API 来配置如何取数。KEDA 允许基于指标配置查询来驱动扩缩。这对 vLLM 同样适用，因为它暴露了 vllm:num_requests_waiting（等待处理的请求数）、vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds / vllm:time_per_output_token_seconds 等指标。KServe 在 Knative 模式下原生支持 KPA，在 Standard 模式下也支持 KEDA（见第 20 页“KServe”）。KEDA 扩缩容器在 InferenceService 规格中通过定义查询来配置，支持直接从 PodMetric 取数，也支持从外部源取数。如果查询只用到 Pod 本地的 vLLM 指标，两种方式等价；此时直接从 Pod 抓取指标能降低扩缩容器延迟、反应更快。外部源更灵活：可以从不同来源（甚至不同 vLLM 副本）收集指标，并做连接多源信息的高级查询（见例 4-4）。
原书第 171 页

Example 4-4. Example of KServe and KEDA

apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1beta1
kind: InferenceService
metadata:
  name: Meta-Llama-3-8B
  annotations:
    serving.kserve.io/deploymentMode: Standard
    serving.kserve.io/autoscalerClass: "keda"
    sidecar.opentelemetry.io/inject: "Meta-Llama-3-8B"
spec:
  predictor:
    model:
      modelFormat:
        name: huggingface
      args:
        - --model_name=llama3
        - --model_id=meta-llama/meta-llama-3-8b
    minReplicas: 1
    maxReplicas: 5
    autoScaling:
      metrics:
        - type: PodMetric
          podmetric:
            metric:
              backend: "opentelemetry"
              metricNames:
                - vllm:num_requests_running
              query: "vllm:num_requests_running"
            target:
              type: Value
              value: "4"
#        - type: External
#          external:
#            metric:
#              backend: "prometheus"
#              serverAddress: "http://prometheus.url:9092"
#              query: "vllm:num_requests_running"
原书第 172 页
  • 必须使用 Standard 模式才能用 KEDA；Knative 用的是 KPA 自带扩缩器。
  • 这个注解启用 KEDA 扩缩器。
  • 收集 Pod 本地指标的一种方式是通过 OpenTelemetry sidecar collector。
  • PodMetric 类型让 KEDA 直接查询 Pod 采集指标。
  • 必须指定 backend，因为 OpenTelemetry 与 Prometheus 协议上有差异。
  • KEDA 决策所用查询可以是单值，也可以是遵循 PromQL 语法的复杂查询。
  • 本例中值 4 表示：基于初步基准（测得更高并发下的延迟分布），当 vLLM 中已有至少 4 个请求在运行时，KEDA 就会在 1–5 副本范围内扩容。
  • 这段被注释的规格是另一种配置：从外部源查询指标。
  • 当类型为 External 时，必须指定执行查询的服务器地址。

The evolution of LLM serving includes the autoscaling topic, and new custom techniques are under development for most complex scenarios, like disaggregated prefill. "Disaggregated Serving" on page 148 describes disaggregated prefill, which differs significantly from traditional Kubernetes autoscaler definitions. It functions more like a "runtime controller" that observes system status and automatically rebalances replica roles or adjusts replica counts for each role.

LLM 服务的演进包含自动扩缩容这一话题；针对更复杂的场景（如解耦式 prefill），新的定制技术正在开发中。第 148 页“解耦式服务”描述的解耦式 prefill，与传统 Kubernetes 扩缩器定义有很大不同。它更像一个“运行时控制器”：观察系统状态，自动重新平衡副本角色或调整每个角色的副本数。

Another emerging approach is llm-d's Workload Variant Autoscaler (WVA), designed specifically for LLM workloads. Instead of just monitoring CPU or request counts, WVA looks at what each pod can handle, considers that different requests require different amounts of work (some generate many tokens, others just a few), and scales based on your actual latency targets. This allows you to run your cluster at higher utilization before adding more pods, while still meeting your performance goals. WVA is part of the llm-d project discussed in "Disaggregated Serving" on page 148.

另一个新兴方案是 llm-d 的 Workload Variant Autoscaler（WVA），专为 LLM 负载设计。WVA 不只看 CPU 或请求数，而是看每个 Pod 能处理什么、不同请求所需工作量不同（有的生成很多 token，有的很少），并基于你实际的延迟目标来扩缩。这让你在加 Pod 之前可以让集群跑在更高利用率下，同时仍满足性能目标。WVA 属于 llm-d 项目，见第 148 页“解耦式服务”。

原书第 173 页

In this section we covered the challenges of configuring a proper autoscaler strategy for LLM deployments. When there are multiple replicas, another challenge requires attention: the tune load balancing strategy. If the load balancer is not LLM-aware, it can produce a suboptimal distribution of the request and impact the stability of system latency. This challenge is described and addressed in "LLM-Aware Routing" on page 139.

本节讨论了为 LLM 部署配置合适扩缩策略的挑战。当存在多个副本时，还有另一个需要关注的挑战：调优负载均衡策略。如果负载均衡器不具备 LLM 感知能力，请求分发可能次优，进而影响系统延迟的稳定性。这个挑战在第 139 页“LLM 感知路由”中描述并解决。

Optimize vLLM Startup Time
优化 vLLM 启动时间

In "Autoscaling" on page 132 we learned how to introduce a more specialized autoscaler configuration for LLMs, but in a real-world scenario, dynamic scaling is not applicable if the time to start a new replica is many minutes.

在第 132 页“自动扩缩容”中，我们了解了如何为 LLM 引入更专门的扩缩器配置；但在真实场景中，如果启动一个新副本需要好几分钟，动态扩缩就无从谈起。

The size of LLMs stretches the core design principles behind Kubernetes itself: some of the biggest LLMs can require almost 1 TB of storage just to store the model itself. They are large.

LLM 的体积挑战着 Kubernetes 自身的核心设计原则：一些最大的 LLM 仅存储模型本身就几乎需要 1 TB。它们太大了。

This aspect makes it hard to configure an efficient autoscaling strategy that can detect workload peak and scale the deployment on the fly. There is a physical bottleneck in the time to transfer a similar amount of data.

这让“检测到负载峰值就立即扩容 deployment”的高效扩缩策略难以配置——传输如此大量数据所需的时间本身就是物理瓶颈。

Performing proper capacity planning, together with performance and scalability tests, is in general a good practice before deploying an application in production. This general advice is even more critical with LLMs.

在应用上线前做合理的容量规划、性能与可扩展性测试，本来就是好实践；对 LLM 而言，这条建议尤为关键。

Optimizing the model's loading time is a multiphase activity that starts with the packaging of the model. This aspect is described in detail in Chapter 2, but this section focuses on the following steps that are performed, from creating the deployment in Kubernetes to when the runtime is ready to process requests:

优化模型加载时间是一个多阶段活动，从模型打包就开始了。这方面第 2 章有详述；本节聚焦于从在 Kubernetes 中创建 deployment 到运行时准备好处理请求之间所经过的步骤：

原书第 174 页
  1. Runtime image provisioning: like any Kubernetes workload, the vLLM runtime is wrapped in a container pulled from a registry to the node. vLLM images aren't small (usually a few GB, <5 GB), and most of that is the GPU framework (e.g. CUDA for NVIDIA) which can't be removed. By default the image is pulled on demand when a pod needs it. The frequency is set by imagePullPolicy — avoid `Always` so the image isn't re-pulled for every replica. Production usually uses IfNotPresent (pull only the first time) or even Never (image pre-pulled to the node). Once the image is local, load time is negligible; just avoid Always. For production, pin specific version tags (e.g. vllm/vllm-openai:v0.12.0) instead of mutable tags like latest, or better, pin by digest (vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:abc123...) to deploy the exact same image everywhere.1. 运行时镜像准备：与其他 Kubernetes 负载一样，vLLM 运行时被打成容器，从镜像仓库拉到节点。vLLM 镜像不小（通常数 GB，小于 5 GB），其中大部分是 GPU 框架（如 NVIDIA 的 CUDA），无法删除。默认情况下，镜像在 Pod 需要时才从仓库拉到节点。拉取频率由 imagePullPolicy 控制：要避免使用 Always，否则每个副本或新 deployment 都会重新下载。生产中通常配成 IfNotPresent（只在首次拉取），甚至 Never（确保镜像已预拉到节点）。镜像在节点上已存在时，加载时间可忽略，这一步只需注意别用 Always。此外，生产部署建议使用具体版本标签（如 vllm/vllm-openai:v0.12.0）而非 latest 这类可变标签；更稳妥的做法是按 digest 哈希固定镜像（vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:abc123...），确保所有环境部署的是完全相同的镜像版本。
  2. Model retrieval and mounting: how the model is stored and fetched greatly affects loading; a poor choice becomes the main bottleneck. Options include: downloading on the fly from Hugging Face; storing on S3-compatible storage; copying to a PVC and mounting as a volume; or packaging as an OCI image. Direct Hugging Face download and S3 are inefficient (often many minutes due to transfer and local copy); PVC and OCI avoid that local copy by mounting the model directly as a volume or sidecar. If Hugging Face or S3 is required, strongly consider KServe's local model cache, keyed by storageUri, ideally on fast SSD/NVMe. With it, Hugging Face/S3 performance becomes equivalent to a PVC. Training workloads face similar storage challenges with large datasets and checkpoints, plus distributed filesystem and checkpoint strategy concerns covered in Chapter 7.2. 模型获取与挂载：模型的存储与获取方式对加载性能影响很大；设计不当会成为主要瓶颈。常见选项包括：从 Hugging Face 即时下载、存在 S3 兼容存储上、复制到 PVC 后作为卷挂载，或打包成 OCI 镜像。其中，直接从 Hugging Face 下载和 S3 方式效率低，因数据传输和本地拷贝往往要好几分钟；而 PVC 和 OCI 方式通过直接把模型作为卷或 sidecar 容器挂载，避免了本地拷贝。若确实需要用 Hugging Face 或 S3，强烈建议使用 KServe 本地模型缓存：以模型 storageUri 为键做本地缓存，最好配合 SSD/NVMe 高速存储。借助 KServe 本地模型缓存，Hugging Face 和 S3 的性能实际上可以达到与 PVC 相当。训练负载在管理大数据集和模型 checkpoint 时面临类似存储挑战，还需考虑分布式文件系统与 checkpoint 策略，见第 7 章。
  3. Starting the runtime: vLLM startup usually takes a second or less. It emits useful logs (see Example 5-1), but from a loading-time standpoint it isn't critical.3. 启动运行时：vLLM 启动通常只需一秒或更短。它会在日志中输出有用信息（见例 5-1），但从加载时间角度看，这一步并不关键。
  4. Loading the model: however the model is retrieved/mounted, when vLLM starts the model must be available, and most of the time is spent copying weights into GPU memory. Reducing time-to-ready for a new replica focuses on this phase. There's a physical upper bound — the I/O bandwidth to GPU memory — but an unoptimized load is far from that limit. At the infrastructure level, NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage can greatly speed transfers with a direct path between NVMe and GPU memory, bypassing the CPU. vLLM has three extensions for this: CoreWeave Tensorizer, Run:ai Model Streamer, and fastsafetensor.4. 加载模型：无论用哪种方式获取和挂载模型，vLLM 启动时模型必须就绪，而大部分时间花在把权重拷贝到 GPU 显存上。缩短新副本就绪时间的工作主要集中在这一阶段。这一阶段有物理上限——到 GPU 显存的 I/O 带宽——但未优化的加载离这个极限还很远。在基础设施层面，NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage 通过在 NVMe 存储与 GPU 显存之间建立直连路径、绕过 CPU，可显著加速数据传输。vLLM 有三个专门针对加载时间的扩展：CoreWeave Tensorizer、Run:ai Model Streamer 和 fastsafetensor。
原书第 175 页

Sidebar: Optimize Model Loading

Run:ai Model Streamer is a fast, highly concurrent implementation of the loading procedure that loads the tensors; it supports different file formats, including safetensor, and different storage options. CoreWeaver's Tensorizer and fastsafetensor both require the model to be prepared with a specific serialization format that is then used to load the model faster. In general, the configuration and the usage in vLLM is similar for both Tensorizer and Model Streamer (see Example 4-5), while fastsafetensor requires setting some additional environment variables. Tensorizer and Model Streamer have larger adoption, compared to fastsafetensor, which is designed specifically to optimize loading from NVMe devices. Given that Model Streamer doesn't require repackaging the model, it is the easiest option to experiment with. However, given that this chapter is about production optimization, it makes sense to consider the other two options too and pick the one that better fits your specific setup.

Run:ai Model Streamer 是一个快速、高并发的张量加载实现，支持 safetensor 等多种文件格式和多种存储方式。CoreWeave 的 Tensorizer 和 fastsafetensor 都要求模型先用特定序列化格式预处理，以便更快加载。总体上，Tensorizer 与 Model Streamer 在 vLLM 中的配置和用法类似（见例 4-5），而 fastsafetensor 还需要额外设置环境变量。相比之下，Tensorizer 和 Model Streamer 采用更广；fastsafetensor 则专为优化从 NVMe 设备加载而设计。由于 Model Streamer 不需要重新打包模型，它是最容易上手试验的选项。但本章关注生产优化，因此也值得考虑另外两个，并选择最适合你具体环境的那个。

Example 4-5. vLLM usage of Run:ai Model Streamer

vllm serve \
 --port=8080 \
 --model=/mnt/models \
 --served-model-name=meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B \
 --load-format runai_streamer \
 --model-loader-extra-config '{"concurrency":16}'
  • load-format 取值 runai_streamer 不需要不同的序列化格式，但会启用 Model Streamer 代码。若取值 tensorizer 则启用 Tensorizer 加载器，但那也要求模型已用 Tensorizer 序列化器保存。
  • 该配置启用 16 个并发线程并行加载模型。其他可用选项见 Model Streamer 环境变量文档。
  1. Warming up the inference engine: once weights are resident in GPU memory, the runtime pre-allocates the KV cache pool and runs profiling. GPU kernels are specialized functions that run math on the GPU; launching thousands individually creates a CPU bottleneck during inference. To remove this overhead, the runtime captures kernel launches into reusable sequences called CUDA (NVIDIA) or HIP (AMD) graphs. This warmup is essential for high-throughput serving but adds to time-to-ready. Recent work caches graph artifacts and uses GPU snapshots to skip repeated init. See vLLM docs on CUDA Graphs.5. 预热推理引擎：权重驻留显存后，运行时会预分配 KV 缓存池并做一些 profiling。GPU kernel 是在 GPU 上执行数学运算的专用函数；逐个启动成千上万个 kernel 会在推理时造成 CPU 瓶颈。为消除这一开销，运行时会把 kernel 启动捕获为可复用的序列，即 CUDA（NVIDIA）或 HIP（AMD）图。这个“预热”阶段对高吞吐服务必不可少，但会增加总就绪时间。近期工作聚焦于缓存图产物、利用 GPU 快照跳过重复初始化。详见 vLLM 文档中关于 CUDA Graphs 的说明。
  2. Exposing the model: once loaded, vLLM exposes the OpenAI-compatible API and many other endpoints and is ready to serve. The API list includes a /health endpoint that can back a readiness probe, as Kubernetes best practices recommend.6. 暴露模型：模型加载完成后，vLLM 会暴露兼容 OpenAI 的 API 及其他端点，开始服务。API 列表中包含 /health 端点，可按 Kubernetes 最佳实践用于配置就绪探针。
原书第 176 页

These are the main steps performed by vLLM to start the runtime, load the model, and expose it. The two phases that take most of the time are downloading the model and loading it in the GPU. We explained how to avoid the download time with proper configuration and how to improve the model loading time using one of the vLLM extensions. The other advice mentioned is to use fast storage options like an NVMe device.

以上是 vLLM 启动运行时、加载模型并暴露服务的主要步骤。最耗时的两个阶段是下载模型和把模型加载到 GPU。我们已经讲了如何通过正确配置避免下载时间、如何用 vLLM 扩展缩短加载时间；另一个建议是使用 NVMe 这类高速存储。

Applying all of these recommendations can reduce the time to scale up vLLM from many minutes to tens of seconds, depending on the size of the model.

综合应用这些建议，可以把 vLLM 扩容时间从数分钟缩短到几十秒，具体取决于模型大小。

LLM-Aware Routing
LLM 感知路由

The previous section showed how to scale to multiple replicas. Now we face a new challenge: how to effectively distribute requests across those replicas. Load balancing requests across different replicas is a challenge that starts to impact the cluster as soon as a single replica is not enough and multiple replicas of the model are provisioned.

上一节讲了如何扩到多副本。现在面临新挑战：如何在这些副本间有效地分发请求。当单副本不够、需要部署多个模型副本时，副本间的负载均衡就开始影响集群了。

The default Kubernetes strategy to dispatch the requests across multiple replicas is round robin. The requests are uniformly distributed and defined, considering the workload of microservices, where monitoring CPU and memory is enough to monitor the current workload of the single replica and decide when to scale.

Kubernetes 默认在多副本间分发请求的策略是轮询（round robin），请求被均匀分布。这种策略是针对微服务负载设计的——在微服务中，监控 CPU 和内存就足以了解单个副本的当前负载并决定何时扩缩。

In reality, the round robin approach has already shown limitations when Kubernetes is deployed on a cloud environment with multizone configuration. Kubernetes introduced topology aware routing to heuristically manage the load and keep traffic within the zone it originated from.

实际上，轮询在多云可用区部署的 Kubernetes 中就已显出局限。Kubernetes 引入了拓扑感知路由，以启发式方式管理负载，把流量留在其来源可用区内。

With the serving of LLMs, the boundaries of Kubernetes are stretched more than in the past, and this requires exploring a different approach for optimizing routing and load balancing a request to a replica. Multiple factors should be considered to perform specialized routing of the requests:

而在 LLM 服务场景下，Kubernetes 的边界被推得更远，需要探索不同的思路来优化请求到副本的路由与负载均衡。要实现专门的请求路由，需要考虑多个因素：

原书第 177 页
  • Each request is different: earlier chapters already highlighted this. There is no correlation between input prompt size and output token count, and generation can run for many seconds. A request's impact on a replica is unpredictable, so routing must consider the actual work a replica is doing — especially how many requests are still queued. vLLM exposes vllm:num_requests_waiting to track exactly this.每个请求都不一样：前面章节已经强调过这一点。输入 prompt 长度与输出 token 数之间没有相关性，生成可能持续数秒。一个请求对副本的影响不可预测，因此路由策略必须考虑副本正在做的实际工作，尤其是还有多少请求在等待处理。vLLM 提供了 vllm:num_requests_waiting 指标来跟踪这一信息。
  • Batching: vLLM batches requests of a configurable size to use all resources and produce more tokens. This is critical for handling more requests in parallel in real-time scenarios. But it isn't always possible to fill a batch, so the router can mix offline requests with real-time ones to fill a batch.批处理：vLLM 会把请求组成可配置大小的批，以用尽可用资源、生成更多 token。这在实时场景下对并行处理更多请求至关重要。但批并不总能填满，路由器可以把离线推理请求和实时请求混在一起来填批。
  • Prefill and decode workload: we already explained the different hardware impact of the prefill and decode phases. Prefill scales with prompt size, so you can dedicate vLLM instances to prefill large prompts — called disaggregated prefill, covered in "Disaggregated Serving" on page 148.Prefill 与 decode 负载：我们已经解释过 prefill 与 decode 两阶段对硬件的不同影响。prefill 阶段直接与 prompt 长度相关，因此可以设计专门的 vLLM 实例来处理大 prompt 的 prefill。这称为解耦式 prefill，见第 148 页“解耦式服务”。
  • KV cache reuse: earlier chapters flagged the KV cache as critical for efficient token generation, but its impact goes beyond single requests. The model has no memory — every request looks brand new. In a chatbot, the whole conversation is resent on every new message, forcing the system to re-prefill all prior messages. The same applies to AI agents when a tool result is fed back to the model with the prior prompt. A router aware of each replica's KV cache state can route requests to exploit that — called prefix-aware routing.KV 缓存复用：前面章节多次提到 KV 缓存是高效生成 token 的关键，但它的影响不止于单个请求。模型本身没有记忆——每个请求看起来都是全新的。例如在聊天机器人中，每来一条新消息都要把整段对话重新发给模型，导致系统不得不重新 prefill 所有历史消息。智能体调用工具后，工具结果连同之前的 prompt 一起回传给模型时也是同样模式。一个感知各副本 KV 缓存状态的路由器，可以据此路由请求——这称为前缀感知路由。
  • Different service-level requirements: real-time requests outrank batch requests, but prioritizing across users can be more complex. Scheduling logic may drop non-critical requests when capacity (waiting-request count and KV cache size) falls below a threshold.不同服务等级要求：实时请求优先级高于批量请求，但不同用户之间的优先级可能更复杂。例如调度逻辑可以在容量（等待请求数与 KV 缓存大小）低于某阈值时，丢弃非关键请求。
  • LoRA adapters: another case where traditional Kubernetes routing falls short is efficiently serving fine-tuned models. Model customization is covered in "Tuning a Model" on page 184. Generally, a fine-tuned model produces a new specialized version deployed as an independent model. But with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) (see "Low-Rank Adaptation" on page 187), the fine-tuned model is saved as a thin layer — the LoRA adapter — composed with the base model. That lets it run in the same runtime instance as an adapter, saving hardware, but breaks the one-model-per-endpoint mapping.LoRA 适配器：传统 Kubernetes 路由模式不太适用的另一个场景是高效服务微调模型。模型定制见第 184 页“调优模型”。一般来说，微调会产生一个专门的新版本，作为独立模型部署。但当使用低秩适配（LoRA）技术（见第 187 页“低秩适配”）时，微调模型被保存为一个薄层——LoRA 适配器——与基座模型组合使用。这让它可以作为适配器跑在同一个运行时实例中，节省硬件，但打破了“一个模型对应一个端点”的映射。

There is a lot of interest in optimizing the inference and reducing its cost, and different initiatives aim to solve or at least improve both of the two scenarios described.

业界对优化推理、降低成本非常关注，各种项目都在试图解决或至少改善上面两种场景。

原书第 178 页

This is an evolving field. The goal that the initiatives have in common is to obtain a gateway component that is aware of the LLM traffic and can optimize it. Figure 4-3 provides a high-level representation of this component.

这是一个快速演进的领域。各项目的共同目标是：得到一个能感知 LLM 流量并加以优化的网关组件。图 4-3 给出了该组件的高层示意。

The LoRA adapter scenario is the simplest from a routing perspective because it is enough to be aware of the mapping between the runtime instance and the LoRA adapter. The main challenge is that there is no one-to-one mapping between the endpoint and the model, and the routing logic of the cluster should support this service discovery logic to forward the request for a LoRA fine-tuned model to where it is available.

从路由角度看，LoRA 适配器场景最简单——只需知道运行时实例与 LoRA 适配器之间的映射即可。主要挑战在于：端点与模型之间不再是一对一映射，集群的路由逻辑需要支持这种服务发现，把针对某个 LoRA 微调模型的请求转发到它所在的位置。

The vLLM runtime has native support to serve the LoRA adapter together with the base model, making both models available under the same endpoint and allowing the user to specify which model to execute directly in the request. See Example 4-6 to learn how to serve LoRA models with vLLM.

vLLM 运行时原生支持把 LoRA 适配器与基座模型一起服务，让两个模型在同一个端点下可用，并允许用户在请求中直接指定要执行哪个模型。例 4-6 展示如何用 vLLM 服务 LoRA 模型。

Example 4-6. Serving LoRA adapters with vLLM

vllm serve meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B \
    --enable-lora \
    --lora-modules my-lora-model=$HOME/.cache/huggingface/

...
curl localhost:8080/v1/models | jq
{
    "object": "list",
    "data": [
        {
            "id": "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B",
            "object": "model",
            ...
        },
        {
            "id": "my-lora-model",
            "object": "model",
            ...
        }
    ]
}

...
curl localhost:8000/v1/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "model": "my-lora-model",
        "prompt": "LoRA is a",
        "max_tokens": 10,
        "temperature": 0
    }' | jq
原书第 179 页
  • 用 vLLM 服务基座模型。
  • 需通过相应参数启用 LoRA 支持。
  • 该参数列出要加载的所有 LoRA 适配器；my-lora-model 是模型名，后面跟本地路径（即容器内保存 LoRA 适配器的路径）。因为是列表，可以加载多个 LoRA 适配器，模型所在文件夹也可以是外部挂载的卷。
  • 基座模型会出现在可用模型列表中。
  • LoRA 模型作为额外的可用模型出现。
  • 执行时可像基座模型一样直接指定 LoRA 模型名，因此从终端用户视角看没有区别。

With vLLM configured to serve multiple LoRA adapters, the next step is to make Kubernetes aware of it so that this information can be used when routing a request. There are projects in Kubernetes to manage the network, and the Kubernetes Gateway API should become the standard way to declare and configure all kinds of gateways.

vLLM 配好服务多个 LoRA 适配器后，下一步是让 Kubernetes 感知这一点，以便路由请求时使用这些信息。Kubernetes 中有一些管理网络的项目，而 Kubernetes Gateway API 应成为声明和配置各类网关的标准方式。

One of the most active communities is the Kubernetes Special Interest Group (SIG) dedicated to model serving, WG-Serving, that incubated the Gateway API Inference Extension (GIE) project designed to optimize the routing and efficiency of LLM serving.

最活跃的社区之一是 Kubernetes 专门负责模型服务的特别兴趣小组 WG-Serving，它孵化了 Gateway API Inference Extension（GIE）项目，旨在优化 LLM 服务的路由与效率。

原书第 180 页

The project is also sometimes referred to as the Inference Gateway. It extends the Kubernetes Gateway API to bring awareness of the inference workload (for background on the Gateway API, see the following sidebar). Before exploring the technical details of GIE, it's important to first understand what distinguishes AI gateways from traditional API gateways and the unique capabilities they provide for LLM workloads.

该项目有时也称为 Inference Gateway。它扩展 Kubernetes Gateway API，使其具备对推理负载的感知能力（Gateway API 背景见下面侧栏）。在深入 GIE 技术细节之前，有必要先理解 AI 网关与传统 API 网关的区别，以及它为 LLM 负载提供的独特能力。

Sidebar: Gateway API

The Gateway API project is a very large, complex project focused on L4 and L7 routing in Kubernetes. The final goal of this official Kubernetes project is defining the next-generation API and implementing Kubernetes ingress, load balancing, and service mesh. It is role oriented and defines a different set of APIs to represent all the aspects of network configuration, from the infrastructure provider, to expose a single application. The Gateway API describes how traffic can be translated to services within the cluster, but it is just the intent, not the actual endpoint or full specification. The creation of a route is protocol-specific like HTTPRoute, attached to a gateway, and defines the rule to forward a request to a service. Many other objects and concepts are part of the full specification but are not critical to explain the Inference Extension and thus are not covered here. For more detailed information, see the API Overview page of the Gateway API website.

Gateway API 是一个非常庞大复杂的项目，聚焦 Kubernetes 中的 L4 与 L7 路由。作为 Kubernetes 官方项目，其最终目标是定义下一代 API，实现 Kubernetes ingress、负载均衡和服务网格。它面向角色建模，定义了一组不同的 API，用于表达从基础设施提供商到暴露单个应用的网络配置方方面面。Gateway API 描述流量如何被翻译到集群内的服务，但它只是意图，并非实际端点或完整规格。路由的创建是协议相关的（如 HTTPRoute），挂载到一个网关上，定义把请求转发到某 Service 的规则。完整规格中还有许多其他对象与概念，但对解释 Inference Extension 并不关键，此处不展开。更多细节见 Gateway API 网站的 API Overview 页面。

From API Gateway to AI Gateway
从 API 网关到 AI 网关

Traditional API gateways were designed for stateless microservices where requests are independent and resource consumption is roughly uniform across endpoints. AI gateway architectures extend this foundation with capabilities specific to LLM workloads, addressing fundamentally different operational challenges.

传统 API 网关是为无状态微服务设计的：请求相互独立，各端点资源消耗大致均匀。AI 网关架构在此基础上扩展了面向 LLM 负载的能力，应对截然不同的运维挑战。

AI gateways enable Model as a Service (MaaS) architectures, where LLM inference capabilities are exposed as managed APIs to multiple users or teams. Similar to how software as a service (SaaS) provides software capabilities over the internet, MaaS delivers model inference as a service by configuring resource quotas, access controls, and usage tracking to ensure fair resource allocation across tenants.

AI 网关支持“模型即服务”（MaaS）架构：把 LLM 推理能力作为托管 API 暴露给多个用户或团队。与 SaaS 通过互联网提供软件能力类似，MaaS 通过配置资源配额、访问控制和使用量追踪，把模型推理作为服务交付，确保多租户之间公平分配资源。

原书第 181 页

Token-based rate limiting and user management
基于 token 的限流与用户管理

User tracking becomes critical for enabling fair access and quota management when serving LLMs in multitenant environments. Unlike traditional APIs where the request is the unit of measurement, LLM serving uses tokens as the fundamental unit of computation. A single request might generate 10 tokens or 10,000 tokens, consuming vastly different amounts of GPU resources and time. This makes traditional request-based rate limiting ineffective for LLM workloads.

在多租户环境中服务 LLM 时，用户追踪对实现公平访问与配额管理至关重要。传统 API 以请求为计量单位，而 LLM 服务以 token 作为基本计算单位。一个请求可能生成 10 个 token，也可能生成 10000 个，消耗的 GPU 资源与时间天差地别。这让传统基于请求的限流对 LLM 负载失效。

The Envoy AI Gateway provides token-based rate limiting capabilities that track and limit token consumption per user or API key, enabling fair resource allocation across multiple tenants accessing the same model deployment. Similarly, Kuadrant offers token rate limiting integrated with Kubernetes-native policy management, allowing platform administrators to define quotas based on tokens generated rather than requests made.

Envoy AI Gateway 提供基于 token 的限流能力，按用户或 API key 追踪并限制 token 消耗量，让多个租户在同一个模型部署上公平分配资源。类似地，Kuadrant 提供与 Kubernetes 原生策略管理集成的 token 限流，让平台管理员按生成的 token 数而非请求数来定义配额。

Evolution of AI gateway capabilities
AI 网关能力的演进

The AI gateway ecosystem is rapidly evolving beyond basic routing and rate limiting to include more sophisticated capabilities:

AI 网关生态正在快速演进，超越基础路由与限流，纳入更复杂的能力：

  • Semantic routing: route based on the semantic content of user requests, sending code-gen queries to code-specialized models and general chat to general-purpose LLMs — optimizing both cost and quality.语义路由：根据用户请求的语义内容路由，把代码生成请求送给代码专用模型，把通用对话送给通用 LLM，同时优化成本与质量。
  • Hybrid routing: dynamically route requests to local on-prem models or remote cloud models based on current load, model availability, and SLA needs. During peak load, overflow traffic goes to cloud endpoints while latency-sensitive requests stay local.混合路由：根据当前负载、模型可用性和 SLA 要求，把请求动态路由到本地部署模型或远程云端模型。例如峰值时把溢出流量送到云端推理端点，而延迟敏感请求留在本地。
  • Model composition: chain multiple models, feeding one model's output into another to implement complex workflows like RAG — a retrieval model first finds relevant documents, then an LLM generates the answer.模型组合：把多个模型串联，让一个模型的输出成为另一个的输入，实现 RAG 这类复杂工作流——先由检索模型找出相关文档，再由 LLM 生成回答。

These capabilities transform AI gateways from simple traffic routers into intelligent orchestration layers that optimize cost, latency, and quality across heterogeneous model deployments.

这些能力把 AI 网关从简单的流量路由器，变成在异构模型部署之间优化成本、延迟和质量的智能编排层。

原书第 182 页

Gateway API Inference Extension
Gateway API Inference Extension

The Gateway API Inference Extension project extends the Kubernetes Gateway API with capabilities optimized for AI inference workloads, including model-aware routing (routing based on model names rather than just URL paths), serving priorities, and incremental model rollouts through traffic splitting.

Gateway API Inference Extension 项目为 Kubernetes Gateway API 扩展了面向 AI 推理负载优化的能力，包括模型感知路由（基于模型名而非仅 URL 路径路由）、服务优先级，以及通过流量切分实现的增量模型发布。

The core resource is InferencePool (v1 stable), which represents a group of pods dedicated to serving AI models that share the same compute configuration, accelerator type, and base model. Platform administrators can configure InferencePools to enable intelligent routing based on metrics like KV cache utilization, queue length, or model-specific characteristics. InferenceObjective (alpha) defines serving objectives and priorities for routing decisions, allowing differentiated service levels for different workloads. Note that InferenceObjective replaced the earlier InferenceModel resource when the API evolved.

核心资源是 InferencePool（v1 稳定版），代表一组专门服务 AI 模型的 Pod，它们共享相同的计算配置、加速器类型和基座模型。平台管理员可以配置 InferencePool，基于 KV 缓存利用率、队列长度或模型特征等指标实现智能路由。InferenceObjective（alpha）定义服务目标与路由决策优先级，允许对不同负载提供差异化服务等级。注意：API 演进后，InferenceObjective 取代了早先的 InferenceModel 资源。

One common use case is LoRA-aware routing, where an InferencePool manages pods serving a base model with multiple LoRA adapters, and the routing logic intelligently distributes requests to pods based on which adapters are loaded. See Example 4-7 for the usage of these APIs.

一个常见用例是 LoRA 感知路由：一个 InferencePool 管理若干服务基座模型并加载多个 LoRA 适配器的 Pod，路由逻辑根据哪些适配器已加载，智能地把请求分发到相应 Pod。这些 API 的用法见例 4-7。

Example 4-7. Example of Gateway API Inference Extension usage

apiVersion: inference.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: InferencePool
metadata:
  name: vllm-llama3-8b-instruct
spec:
  targetPorts:
    - number: 8000
  selector:
    app: vllm-llama3-8b-instruct
  endpointPickerRef:
    name: vllm-llama3-8b-epp
    port: 9002
    failureMode: FailClose
---
apiVersion: inference.networking.x-k8s.io/v1alpha2
kind: InferenceObjective
metadata:
  name: high-priority-inference
spec:
  priority: 1
  poolRef:
    group: inference.networking.k8s.io
    name: vllm-llama3-8b-instruct
---
apiVersion: inference.networking.x-k8s.io/v1alpha2
kind: InferenceObjective
metadata:
  name: standard-inference
spec:
  priority: 2
  poolRef:
    group: inference.networking.k8s.io
    name: vllm-llama3-8b-instruct
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: vllm-llama3-8b-epp
spec:
  selector:
    app: vllm-llama3-8b-epp
  ports:
    - port: 9002
      targetPort: 9002
原书第 183 页
  • InferencePool 资源使用稳定的 v1 API，组为 inference.networking.k8s.io。
  • targetPorts 是数组，定义模型服务器 Pod 暴露的端口，最多支持 8 个。
  • selector 字段用标签匹配指定哪些 Pod 属于该池。运行 vLLM 的 Pod 通过 --enable-lora 标志同时服务基座与 LoRA 模型（见例 4-6）。
  • endpointPickerRef 引用 Endpoint Picker 服务，后者用自定义算法实现智能路由、为每个请求挑选最佳 Pod。
  • InferenceObjective 定义服务目标与路由决策优先级。该资源目前为 alpha（v1alpha2）。
  • priority 字段指定服务优先级，数值越大表示请求越关键、应被优先处理。
  • Endpoint Picker 服务通过 Envoy External Processing 协议实现路由逻辑。

The concept of an InferencePool is flexible and represents a set of inference-focused pods. The routing logic can use information from different sources (like vLLM metrics) to decide which pod should process the request or even refuse requests based on priorities and current workload. LoRA-aware routing is one of the key use cases, allowing intelligent distribution of requests to pods serving specific model adapters.

InferencePool 的概念很灵活，代表一组以推理为中心的 Pod。路由逻辑可以使用来自不同来源的信息（如 vLLM 指标）来决定哪个 Pod 处理请求，甚至根据优先级和当前负载拒绝请求。LoRA 感知路由是关键用例之一，它让请求被智能分发到服务特定模型适配器的 Pod。

原书第 184 页

Gateway API Inference Extension has been designed with the idea of extending the routing decision logic to be increasingly more specific for the LLM workload. Envoy proxy is the core component that enables this flexibility. It is a highly scalable HTTP proxy implementation used for many different use cases thanks to the ability to plug custom processing logic via External Processing. The External Processing (ext_proc) filter defines a gRPC protocol that can be implemented by external services to be registered as a processing step that can read and modify both the HTTP headers and the request body.

Gateway API Inference Extension 的设计思路，是让路由决策逻辑越来越针对 LLM 负载。Envoy 代理是实现这种灵活性的核心组件。它是一个高度可扩展的 HTTP 代理，凭借通过 External Processing 挂载自定义处理逻辑的能力，被用于各种场景。External Processing（ext_proc）过滤器定义了一套 gRPC 协议，外部服务可以实现它，注册为一个处理步骤，能够读取并修改 HTTP 头和请求体。

The Gateway API Inference Extension project adopts the External Processing concept to define the Endpoint Picker protocol (EPP). An Endpoint Picker, as the name suggests, can pick an endpoint from the InferencePool, and each implementation of this component must support the Envoy External Processing protocol so that it can be invoked by the Envoy proxy during processing.

Gateway API Inference Extension 项目采用 External Processing 概念，定义了 Endpoint Picker 协议（EPP）。顾名思义，Endpoint Picker 从 InferencePool 中挑选一个端点；该组件的每种实现都必须支持 Envoy External Processing 协议，以便在处理过程中被 Envoy 代理调用。

One of the most interesting Endpoint Picker implementations is the inference-scheduler that is part of the llm-d project (see "Disaggregated Serving" on page 148 for more details). This specific Endpoint Picker implementation supports different filters and scoring logic; for example, it is possible to configure metrics scraping from the different vLLM instances and use the vllm:num_requests_waiting metric to pick the replica with the lowest number of requests waiting.

最有意思的 Endpoint Picker 实现之一是 inference-scheduler，它属于 llm-d 项目（详见第 148 页“解耦式服务”）。这个特定实现支持不同的过滤器和打分逻辑；例如，可以配置从各 vLLM 实例抓取指标，并用 vllm:num_requests_waiting 挑选等待请求数最少的副本。

From a Kubernetes perspective, each Endpoint Picker is a different deployment that is usually deployed in the same namespace where the model is deployed, but it is not required. The only requirement is that it has access to the container where vLLM is running to collect the metrics and that the instance of the gateway (Envoy proxy) can reach the Endpoint Picker. The communication can be secured via mTLS or in general via certificate.

从 Kubernetes 视角看，每个 Endpoint Picker 都是一个独立 deployment，通常部署在模型所在的同一命名空间，但并非必须。唯一要求是：它能访问运行 vLLM 的容器以采集指标，且网关实例（Envoy 代理）能访问到 Endpoint Picker。通信可以通过 mTLS 或一般的证书来加密。

In "Disaggregated Serving" on page 148, the Inference Gateway will be used together with other components in a more complicated setup to distribute the inference workload, but the usage of a smarter routing logic has already had a big impact on scalability.

在第 148 页“解耦式服务”中，Inference Gateway 会与其他组件一起用在更复杂的架构里分发推理负载；但仅使用更智能的路由逻辑，就已经对可扩展性产生了巨大影响。

Gateway API Inference Extension is not the only option, and neither is it the only open source project focusing on the creation of an AI gateway. The Envoy AI Gateway is another project using Envoy proxy to build AI gateway capabilities, reusing the Gateway API Inference Extension and extending it with other user-facing features, like token-based rate limiting and security. Another example is the vLLM Production Stack project that has introduced an external and sharable KV cache storage to extend the benefit of reusing the KV cache content across different instances.

Gateway API Inference Extension 并非唯一选择，也不是唯一专注于 AI 网关的开源项目。Envoy AI Gateway 是另一个用 Envoy 代理构建 AI 网关能力的项目，它复用 Gateway API Inference Extension，并扩展了其他面向用户的功能，如基于 token 的限流与安全。另一个例子是 vLLM Production Stack 项目，它引入了外部、可共享的 KV 缓存存储，把跨实例复用 KV 缓存内容的收益进一步扩大。

原书第 185 页

Finally, there is the already mentioned llm-d project that extends the Gateway API Inference Extension to integrate it more and more with vLLM runtime, including distributed and shared KV cache and disaggregated prefill. It is one of the most advanced solutions currently available for large-scale LLM deployments, and it will be used as a reference in "Disaggregated Serving" on page 148.

最后是前面提到的 llm-d 项目，它扩展 Gateway API Inference Extension，使其与 vLLM 运行时集成得越来越深，包括分布式共享 KV 缓存和解耦式 prefill。它是目前大规模 LLM 部署最先进的方案之一，将在第 148 页“解耦式服务”中作为参考。

While the Gateway API Inference Extension provides powerful capabilities, the configuration of InferencePools, InferenceModels, and Endpoint Pickers can become complex for production deployments. KServe's LLMInferenceService API simplifies this by providing a higher-level abstraction that automatically manages the underlying gateway components. The LLMInferenceServiceConfig acts as a preset template that encapsulates common configuration patterns for intelligent routing, KV cache-aware scheduling, and disaggregated serving, hiding the low-level complexity while still allowing customization when needed (see Example 1-12 for configuration examples).

尽管 Gateway API Inference Extension 功能强大，但在生产部署中配置 InferencePool、InferenceModel 和 Endpoint Picker 可能变得复杂。KServe 的 LLMInferenceService API 通过提供更高层抽象来简化这一切，自动管理底层网关组件。LLMInferenceServiceConfig 相当于一个预置模板，封装了智能路由、KV 缓存感知调度和解耦式服务的常见配置模式，隐藏底层复杂度，同时在需要时仍允许定制（配置示例见例 1-12）。

Disaggregated Serving
解耦式服务

In addition to LLM-aware routing, many other optimizations can be applied to scale the LLM service in production. The more stringent the latency and scalability requirements, the more complex the configuration becomes.

除了 LLM 感知路由，还有许多其他优化可以用于在生产中扩展 LLM 服务。延迟与可扩展性要求越严苛，配置就越复杂。

The disaggregated serving approach distributes LLM serving by integrating an LLM-aware router with distributed KV cache and disaggregated prefill optimizations. Before going into more detail, it is important to highlight that similar configuration makes the deployment more similar to an appliance instead of a traditional Kubernetes deployment, and it is designed for very large-scale deployments where few models are served in a single cluster.

解耦式服务方法通过把 LLM 感知路由器与分布式 KV 缓存、解耦式 prefill 优化整合在一起来分布式地服务 LLM。在深入细节之前需要强调：这种配置让部署更像一台“设备”而非传统 Kubernetes 部署，它是为超大规模、单集群只服务少数模型的场景设计的。

Multiple projects have been created with the goal of implementing disaggregated serving. The most famous are NVIDIA Dynamo and llm-d, and the main difference is the focus: NVIDIA Dynamo is specialized and deeply integrated with NVIDIA hardware, while llm-d aims to support different hardware and integrate existing open source projects, thus leveraging the ecosystem.

已有多个项目以实现解耦式服务为目标。最著名的是 NVIDIA Dynamo 和 llm-d，主要区别在于侧重点：NVIDIA Dynamo 专门化、与 NVIDIA 硬件深度集成；llm-d 则旨在支持多种硬件、整合现有开源项目，从而利用整个生态。

Everything described in this chapter up to this section is applicable to a traditional Kubernetes cluster that has at least one node with GPUs, but this is not enough to support disaggregated serving. As soon as the runtime is distributed, and in particular the KV cache is shared across different deployments, the network bandwidth available to share the KV cache blocks becomes critical and a dedicated network configuration is required to obtain the benefit of the distribution.

本章到目前为止描述的内容，都适用于至少有一个 GPU 节点的传统 Kubernetes 集群；但这还不足以支持解耦式服务。一旦运行时被分布式部署，尤其是 KV 缓存跨 deployment 共享时，用于传输 KV 缓存块的网络带宽就变得至关重要，需要专门的网络配置才能从分布式中获益。

原书第 186 页

The traditional pod network interface is usually backed by an Ethernet connection that has up to 10–20 Gbps, while the bandwidth requirement is about one order of magnitude higher—about 500–600 Gbps!

传统 Pod 网络接口通常背后是 10–20 Gbps 的以太网，而带宽需求要高出约一个数量级——约 500–600 Gbps！

NVIDIA developed a specialized network stack to match a similar requirement. It is possible to connect multiple GPUs using NVLink and NVSwitch to break the limit of Tbps in some configurations.

NVIDIA 开发了专用网络栈来匹配这种需求。在某些配置下，可以用 NVLink 和 NVSwitch 连接多块 GPU，突破 Tbps 级别的限制。

Other options that are not specific to NVIDIA hardware are based on Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) and RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) to reach up to 800 Gbps. InfiniBand is a famous RDMA implementation that was created many years before generative AI to support high-performance computing (HPC), and now similar configurations are not limited to supercomputers but might become more widely adopted with the evolution of generative AI workloads.

其他不依赖 NVIDIA 硬件的方案基于远程直接内存访问（RDMA）和融合以太网上的 RDMA（RoCE），可达 800 Gbps。InfiniBand 是著名的 RDMA 实现，远在生成式 AI 出现之前就为高性能计算（HPC）而建；如今类似配置不再局限于超级计算机，随着生成式 AI 负载演进，可能被更广泛采用。

After the introduction of the additional network requirements to support the distribution of the serving runtime, we will now introduce two optimizations that can be implemented with a similar cluster available: distributed KV cache and disaggregated prefill:

在介绍了分布式服务运行时所需的额外网络要求后，下面介绍在这样的集群上可以实施的两项优化：分布式 KV 缓存和解耦式 prefill：

  • Distributed KV cache: the KV cache has come up many times — it is critical for efficient LLM execution. The base intuition is simple: wouldn't it be great to store KV blocks in an external cache and reuse them? Two benefits: cache size is no longer bounded by local memory, and blocks can be shared across replicas. This only pays off if transferring KV blocks between instances is very fast (milliseconds). The idea is natural but the implementation is complex; two projects focus on it: LMCache ("Redis for LLMs," an API to cache KV blocks — great for very long prompts as in RAG, avoiding re-prefilling every request) and NVIDIA NIXL (a small library to accelerate point-to-point communication for AI runtimes, abstracting over GPU/CPU memory and file-to-object storage). The two can be used together; llm-d leverages both. NIXL is flexible enough to use even without disaggregated serving — e.g. extend GPU memory with CPU memory for a larger KV cache. Distributing the KV cache also affects the LLM-aware router: even if the cache is shared, it's far cheaper to route to a replica that already holds the needed blocks than to suffer a cache miss and a block transfer.分布式 KV 缓存：KV 缓存已经提过多次，它对高效执行 LLM 至关重要。基本直觉很简单：如果能把 KV 块存在某个外部缓存里、需要时复用，不是很好吗？这有两个主要好处：KV 缓存实例大小不再受本地内存限制，而且可以跨副本共享这些块。不难想象，只有当 KV 缓存数据在实例间传输非常快（毫秒级）时，这种优化才有正收益。想法很自然，但实现很复杂，有两个专门为此而生的新项目：LMCache 和 NVIDIA Inference Xfer Library（NIXL）。LMCache 自称“LLM 的 Redis”，实现了缓存 KV 块的 API；其收益主要体现在输入 prompt 很长的场景（如 RAG），这样就不必对每个新请求都重新 prefill。另一方面，NIXL 是一个目标更聚焦的小型库：加速 AI 运行时之间的点对点通信，对不同类型的内存（GPU、CPU）和存储（从文件到远端对象存储）做一层抽象。这两个项目可以一起使用，llm-d 项目就利用了各自的优点。NIXL 尤其灵活，甚至可以在不解耦服务的情况下使用，例如把 CPU 内存作为 GPU 显存的扩展，获得更大的 KV 缓存。KV 缓存的分布式化对 LLM 感知路由器也有影响：即便 KV 缓存分布式地对所有副本可访问，把请求转发到已经有所需 KV 块的副本，仍然比“缓存未命中再传输块”高效得多。
  • Disaggregated prefill: prefill is the first phase of request processing — the input prompt is processed and the first token produced. Then decode produces tokens one by one until the stream ends. Prefill is compute-bound and drives TTFT; decode is memory-bound and drives ITL (see "Understanding LLM Fundamentals" on page xxv). Because the two have different natures, disaggregated prefill splits them into two pools so they can be scaled and tuned independently — e.g. if the workload is mostly long prompts, the prefill pool needs more replicas. The main challenge: prefill initializes the KV cache, so it must be transferred from the prefill instance to the decode instance to continue generation. Luckily the distributed KV cache above applies here too. Implementation-wise, disaggregated prefill needs the distributed KV cache plus a routing component.解耦式 prefill：prefill 是请求处理的第一阶段——处理输入 prompt 并产生第一个 token；之后 decode 阶段逐 token 生成直到流结束。第一阶段是计算密集型，影响首 token 时间（TTFT）；第二阶段是内存密集型，影响 token 间延迟（ITL）（详见第 xxv 页“理解 LLM 基础”）。由于两阶段负载性质不同，解耦式 prefill 把 prefill 与 decode 拆到两组不同的实例池中，以便独立扩缩和调优；例如，如果负载主要是长输入 prompt，prefill 阶段就需要更多副本来处理。启用这种方式的主要挑战是：prefill 阶段负责初始化 KV 缓存，因此必须把它从 prefill 实例传输到 decode 实例才能继续生成。幸运的是，前面描述的分布式 KV 缓存也适用于这个场景。从实现角度看，解耦式 prefill 需要分布式 KV 缓存和一个路由组件。
原书第 187 页

Now that all the ingredients to build a disaggregated serving stack have been introduced, it is possible to describe the end-to-end architecture of a similar solution. The design described in Figure 4-4 represents the entire stack, from the Gateway API to vLLM, including all llm-d components and KServe LLMInferenceService to manage the deployment lifecycle.

介绍完构建解耦式服务栈所需的全部要素后，就可以描述类似方案的端到端架构了。图 4-4 描述的设计代表了整栈：从 Gateway API 到 vLLM，包括所有 llm-d 组件，以及用于管理 deployment 生命周期的 KServe LLMInferenceService。

原书第 188 页

The development and optimization of the serving stack is far from completed. New models and new model architectures are defined almost every week, and the same happens on the runtime development side. Solutions like disaggregated serving introduce higher coupling of the different components, necessary when you have very large-scale deployments. The adoption of a similar solution increases the complexity to manage from a platform perspective, but there is ongoing work to simplify the deployment and the lifecycle management in the llm-d community and in other projects like KServe. Disaggregated serving is based on the contribution of many different communities; for example, the disaggregated prefill topology was introduced by the Mooncake project and then adopted by NVIDIA Dynamo and llm-d. This is the power of open source development!

服务栈的开发与优化远未结束。几乎每周都有新模型、新模型架构出现，运行时开发侧也一样。像解耦式服务这样的方案引入了更高的组件耦合——在超大规模部署中这是必要的。采用这种方案会增加平台视角下的管理复杂度，但 llm-d 社区以及 KServe 等项目正在努力简化部署与生命周期管理。解耦式服务建立在众多社区的贡献之上；例如解耦式 prefill 拓扑由 Mooncake 项目提出，后被 NVIDIA Dynamo 和 llm-d 采用。这就是开源开发的力量！

原书第 189 页

Lessons Learned
本章小结

In this chapter we explored the continuous optimization required for production LLM inference across model selection, runtime configuration, and infrastructure topology.

本章讨论了生产级 LLM 推理所需的持续优化，涵盖模型选择、运行时配置与基础设施拓扑。

Model selection cannot rely solely on parameter count or general benchmarks. Task-specific evaluation using domain-relevant datasets reveals accuracy differences that general leaderboards obscure. Compression techniques like quantization and pruning reduce memory footprint and improve throughput, but quality degradation varies by model architecture. Benchmark your specific workload before committing to a compression strategy.

模型选择不能只看参数量或通用基准。用领域相关数据集做任务专属评估，才能发现通用排行榜掩盖的准确率差异。量化、剪枝等压缩技术可降低内存占用、提升吞吐，但质量下降幅度因模型架构而异。在确定压缩策略前，务必先对你的具体负载做基准测试。

Autoscaling LLM workloads differs fundamentally from traditional application scaling. Token-based metrics (TTFT, TPOT) and KV cache utilization provide better scaling signals than request rate or CPU usage. Scale-to-zero remains impractical for most LLM deployments due to model loading times measured in minutes, not seconds. Pre-warming replicas and setting conservative minimum replica counts prevent the cold-start latency spikes that destroy user experience.

LLM 负载的自动扩缩与传统应用扩缩有根本不同。基于 token 的指标（TTFT、TPOT）和 KV 缓存利用率，比请求速率或 CPU 使用率提供更好的扩缩信号。由于模型加载以分钟而非秒计，缩容到零对多数 LLM 部署仍不现实。预热副本并设置保守的最小副本数，可以避免破坏用户体验的冷启动延迟尖峰。

vLLM startup optimization directly impacts deployment velocity and recovery time. Model caching on persistent volumes, optimized container images, and strategic use of init containers reduce initialization from minutes to seconds. These optimizations compound during rollouts, autoscaling events, and failure recovery.

vLLM 启动优化直接影响部署速度与恢复时间。在持久卷上缓存模型、优化容器镜像、策略性使用 init 容器，可把初始化从分钟级降到秒级。这些优化在发布、扩缩事件和故障恢复中会持续叠加收益。

Request routing strategies affect both latency and cost. Cache-aware routing that directs similar requests to the same replica maximizes KV cache hit rates, reducing redundant computation. Disaggregated serving architectures separate prefill and decode phases across specialized hardware, enabling independent scaling of compute-bound and memory-bound workloads.

请求路由策略同时影响延迟与成本。缓存感知路由把相似请求导向同一副本，最大化 KV 缓存命中率，减少冗余计算。解耦式服务架构把 prefill 与 decode 分到专用硬件上，让计算密集型与内存密集型负载可以独立扩缩。

Advanced topologies like disaggregated serving introduce operational complexity that requires specialized Kubernetes resources like LeaderWorkerSet, topology-aware scheduling, and high-bandwidth networking. These patterns mirror distributed training workloads more than traditional stateless services, demanding infrastructure planning that considers GPU interconnect topology and network bandwidth alongside compute capacity.

解耦式服务这类高级拓扑引入了运维复杂度，需要 LeaderWorkerSet、拓扑感知调度、高带宽网络等专门的 Kubernetes 资源。这些模式更像分布式训练负载，而非传统无状态服务，要求基础设施规划在算力之外，同时考虑 GPU 互联拓扑与网络带宽。

With all these optimizations in place, the next question becomes: how do you know they are working? The next chapter explores observability for LLM workloads, covering the metrics, logs, and traces that reveal whether your production setup performs as expected.

所有这些优化就位后，下一个问题是：你怎么知道它们真的在起作用？下一章探讨 LLM 负载的可观测性，介绍用来判断生产环境是否如预期运行的指标、日志和链路追踪。
